label: Sticky
description: Posts a message that the operator configures in the client's settings UI.

message.label: Message
message.hint: The text posted by /say. Change it any time from the bot's settings page.

config.text: Sticky is ready. Use /say to post your configured message.

config.name: say
config.description: Post the configured message to the room.

constraints: The message is a user-scoped setting. It applies across every room the operator has granted the bot in.
The message is posted publicly. There is no private output mode.
The setting is declared on the recipe. The client renders a settings field for it in the operator's bot settings page.
The install message is fixed. It does not read the setting.
